subagents.for: Very thorough search to locate all auth-related files including middleware, routes, controllers, session stores, and rate limiters across the codebase
Trace each user role's complete authentication journey independently and analyze permission check logic
Design remediation strategy addressing architectural trade-offs before implementing fixes

skills.name: /security-review
skills.when: After discovery phase completes to audit authentication paths, session handling, and authorization checks

skills.name: /review
skills.when: Before merging any remediation changes to ensure quality standards are met

hooks_to_consider.for: Guard against accidental edits to critical auth middleware during initial discovery phase
Automatically save findings and progress to prevent loss of security audit results between sessions
Auto-format and log all security-sensitive file modifications for audit trail

execution_order: 1. Start in Plan Mode and use Explore subagent (very thorough) to map all auth-related files
2. Create task list with TaskCreate for tracking audit phases
3. Use general-purpose subagent to trace each role's auth journey and document flows
4. Run /security-review skill on identified authentication paths and session handling
5. Analyze findings and rank issues by severity (critical > logic > improvements)
6. Use Plan subagent to design remediation strategy with architectural considerations
7. Enter implementation phase with structured fixes prioritized by severity
8. Apply fixes with PostToolUse logging for audit trail
9. Run /review before merging any remediation changes
10. Verify fixes with testing and document migration strategy
recipe.rationale: This plan requires systematic discovery before remediation can begin. Plan Mode provides structure for the multi-phase approach, Explore subagent handles the file discovery efficiently, and /security-review ensures comprehensive coverage of security vulnerabilities. Task tracking is essential given the complex, multi-step nature of security fixes across multiple auth flows.
